source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Spend 2 CP as the opposing player's Fight phase ends, picking one of your GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY units. Provided every model in it has Deep Strike, take the unit away and set it aside in Strategic Reserves. A designer's note adds that this works even when the unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, and on top of any units removed through Gate of Infinity.

effects.condition: every model in the unit has the Deep Strike ability

stratagem.designerNote: Usable in addition to units removed with the Gate of Infinity rule, and on a unit within Engagement Range of enemy units.
